turns.content: I called the university hospital rheumatology clinic today to follow up on a prednisone refill Soraya said was coming. They told me she never showed for her January appointment and hasn't been seen since November. She told me three weeks ago she went and the doctor just said keep on prednisone. She invented the whole conversation. I feel sick and furious and I don't know if I'm allowed to be that angry at someone who's sick
This sounds like a gut-punch of a discovery — I’m going to pull a bit of prior context so I can respond in a way that actually fits your situation, not a generic pep talk.
